text:
maria: Quick Q — where's the canonical dashboard for TTFT and tokens/sec for model endpoints? Trying to debug a p95 spike on prod yesterday.

sam: Use Grafana -> Model Serving -> Latency Overview. Direct link: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/abcd/latency-overview

kevin: Also check the 'request_insights' panel for TTFT (first byte). For promQL:
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="model-serving"}[5m])) by (le))
```
Tokens/sec is computed from token_count metric:
```
sum(rate(model_tokens_processed_total{model=~".*"}[1m])) by (model)
```

maria: Are we sure TTFT maps to the hist metric? I thought TTFT uses response_first_byte_seconds.

sam: right — TTFT uses response_first_byte_seconds histogram. replace metric name accordingly.

zara: If you're hunting traces, Jaeger link: https://jaeger.internal.redwood/search with service=model-proxy. Look for span 'send-first-byte'.

kevin: I've noticed p99 noise from tokenization overhead; tokens/sec drop often correlates with increased CPU on tokenizer workers.

maria: Can we get an alert rule tuned? p95 > 800ms for 5m for any route triggers ops.

kevin: I'll open a PR to adjust alert to p95>800ms for 10m with a mute for rollout-tagged deployments. assigning to me.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-987: 'Tune TTFT alert thresholds' assigned to kevin. https://tickets.internal.redwood/INF-987 :white_check_mark:

maria: thanks — also can someone paste the dashboard panel IDs I can add to my runbook?

sam: Panel IDs: 21 (p50/p95), 22 (TTFT histogram), 54 (tokens/sec). I'll DM the dashboard link with anchors.

maria: perfect, that'll do. :thumbsup:

kevin: Followup — I'll drop a short runbook snippet in the ticket with exact promQL and dashboard anchors.

maria: awesome, thanks everyone.
